Subject: Performance benchmark readout — scheduling

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for running the initial workload against our optimized runtime. We'd like to schedule a 60-minute readout to walk through the latency/throughput numbers, highlight tail-latency behavior, and discuss next steps (canary, capacity, and procurement).

Proposed attendees:
- Marissa Cole (Account Exec, Redwood)
- Ethan Park (Solutions Eng, Redwood)
- Your Eng Team (performance/infra)
- Procurement (for contracting/timeline)
- Security/Compliance (quick Q&A if needed)

Proposed times (PDT):
- Tue, Jun 22 — 10:00–11:00
- Wed, Jun 23 — 14:00–15:00

If those don't work, please share a few windows (and your timezone). We'll loop in security and procurement once we have a firm slot. I can also circulate an agenda and the preliminary slides ahead of time.

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the invite. The eng team is excited. Unfortunately Jun 22–23 are tough for us: we have a feature freeze and a procurement review that day. Can we aim for the week after?

Suggested windows (ET):
- Tue, Jun 29 — 11:00–12:00 ET
- Thu, Jul 1 — 15:00–16:00 ET

Looping in Bob from procurement (bob.procurement@acme-cloud.com) to confirm budget/contract timing. Also adding acme-eng-team for confirmation on who will present the infra numbers.

Alice —

Thanks — Jun 29 at 11:00 ET works for our team. I've added internal folks from Redwood: Ethan (SE) to go over the test methodology and Nikhil to help coordinate contracting. I'm also looping Neha from Security so she can join the short compliance Q&A.

Agenda (60 min):
- 5m Introductions & goals
- 25m Results deep-dive (latency, p50/p95/p99, tail, KV cache effects) — Ethan
- 15m Ops/rollout discussion (canary, routing, dedicated capacity) — Marissa
- 10m Procurement & next steps — Nikhil/Bob

I will send a calendar invite and attach the preliminary slides and the raw latency CSV ahead of the meeting. Bob — if you have a procurement checklist or required docs, please share. Neha — I'll attach our SOC2 summary and security FAQ; will that be sufficient ahead of time?

Thanks,
Marissa
